note: P4_7 预授权策略：knowledge-preauthorization-contract.md 第 3 节八类必填边界的结构化声明（拟议语义，非当前原生配置字段）。目标有效受众规则见 audienceRule；授权不自动续期；未知一律 fail-closed。

validity.renewal: manual re-issue through the original issuance path only; no auto-renewal

sources.evidenceContract: each source needs permission evidence COMPLETE with every principal mapped; INCOMPLETE/ERROR/service-account-only stays blocked (U06); a 403 is never an empty set

purpose.outboundMaterialProfile: summary/derivative knowledge only; publication does not authorize exporting full source material to arbitrary tools

allowedAudience.reason: registered from the live pilot readback: the managed collection has exactly one member (the instance owner), the page/public share registry is empty, and member/offboarded calls are denied 403 — but the attachment channel is UNVERIFIED (upload infrastructure error: object-store region unset), so the registration stays PARTIAL and a LIVE audience claim missing any required channel is fail-closed (TARGET_CHANNEL_NOT_READ); auto-publish on the committed state stays blocked while the source-side grants carry no disclosure audience

target.draftRule: drafts never enter a larger audience before review; publish=false is not a privacy guarantee

quality.versionBinding: review and decision bind the frozen payload digest; any change invalidates both (U04)

lifecycle.preWriteRecheck: the decision receipt must recheck against current ledger/model/policy digests and the real clock immediately before the write (U03)
lifecycle.revocationEffect: a revocation in the ledger blocks the next decision and stales any prior receipt; agents cannot modify time or copy old receipts past it
